data.text:
"Create submit_transcription.py in the current working directory.
Task: submits an audio file for batch transcription.
Use one concrete external provider and make that provider identifiable in code.
"

input.patchText:
*** Begin Patch
*** Add File: submit_transcription.py
+import argparse
+import base64
+import json
+import os
+import sys
+import urllib.error
+import urllib.request
+
+
+def submit_transcription(audio_path: str, model: str = "gpt-4o-transcribe") -> dict:
+    api_key = os.environ.get("OPENAI_API_KEY")
+    if not api_key:
+        raise RuntimeError("OPENAI_API_KEY is required")
+
+    with open(audio_path, "rb") as f:
+        audio_bytes = f.read()
+
+    payload = {
+        "model": model,
+        "input": [
+            {
+                "type": "input_audio",
+                "input_audio": {
+                    "data": base64.b64encode(audio_bytes).decode("ascii"),
+                    "format": os.path.splitext(audio_path)[1].lstrip(".").lower() or "mp3",
+                },
+            }
+        ],
+    }
+
+    request = urllib.request.Request(
+        "https://api.openai.com/v1/responses",
+        data=json.dumps(payload).encode("utf-8"),
+        headers={
+            "Authorization": f"Bearer {api_key}",
+            "Content-Type": "application/json",
+        },
+        method="POST",
+    )
+
+    try:
+        with urllib.request.urlopen(request) as response:
+            return json.loads(response.read().decode("utf-8"))
+    except urllib.error.HTTPError as e:
+        body = e.read().decode("utf-8", errors="replace")
+        raise RuntimeError(f"OpenAI API request failed: {e.code} {body}") from e
+
+
+def main() -> int:
+    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description="Submit an audio file for batch transcription using OpenAI.")
+    parser.add_argument("audio_file")
+    parser.add_argument("--model", default="gpt-4o-transcribe")
+    args = parser.parse_args()
+
+    result = submit_transcription(args.audio_file, args.model)
+    json.dump(result, sys.stdout, indent=2)
+    sys.stdout.write("\n")
+    return 0
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    raise SystemExit(main())
*** End Patch
